Subject: Follow-up: deployment mode & isolation SLOs (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)

Hi Jane —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and the questions we said we'd follow up on: 

- Goal: evaluate whether FinTechCo should start on Redwood Hosted API for fast time-to-value or move to Dedicated capacity / Private VPC for stronger isolation and compliance.
- Primary concerns you raised: noisy-neighbor variability on shared pools, isolation boundaries for production workloads, and p99 latency SLOs under bursty trading-like traffic.

Action items / information requested from FinTechCo:
1) Peak concurrent QPS and typical traffic profile (burst size, weekday vs batch windows).
2) Target p99 latency for inference (ms) and acceptable error budget.
3) Data residency / SOC2 / encryption requirements that would push you toward Private.
4) Procurement timeline and who to loop in from legal/procurement.

What we promised from our side:
- Drafted a quick SLA + isolation tradeoff matrix (attached: SLA-diff-matrix.xlsx).
- High-level Dedicated architecture doc and sizing notes (attached: redwood-dedicated-arch.pdf).
- SOC2 summary + redacted report link (will share on request).

Suggested next steps:
- 60-min technical deep-dive with your infra team to walk isolation controls, dedicated pool sizing, and fallback routing (Proposed: Fri 2/20 or early next week).
- If Dedicated looks necessary, we can run a short benchmark with sample payloads to validate p99 under your profile.

I'll leave Priyom on the thread to handle the infra sizing and benchmark coordination.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: SLA-diff-matrix.xlsx, redwood-dedicated-arch.pdf

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the attachments. A few answers from our side: 

- Traffic profile: average 8-12 QPS with bursts up to ~60 QPS for short windows (1-3 minutes) during market opens; occasional batch spikes overnight.
- Latency target: p99 <= 150ms for inference calls that affect customer-facing flows; p50/p90 targets are less strict.
- Compliance: we need SOC2 + encryption-at-rest and in-transit. Regulated data must remain in our AWS account (so Private or Dedicated with VPC peering preferred).
- Procurement: procurement@fintechco.com is on copy - timeline is end of Q1 for a pilot if we can validate performance and isolation.

We'd prefer Dedicated capacity if the cost delta vs Hosted is reasonable and if you can demonstrate stable p99 under our burst profile (noisy-neighbor risk is the main blocker). Can you share SOC2 report and any benchmark/benchmark plan?

Looping in procurement to confirm contracting path.

Thanks,
Jane
Head of AI, FinTechCo
jane.doe@fintechco.com
